cases.name: Lineida Olivera
cases.about:
She was born in Puerto Rico. Three weeks before she disappeared, Ms. Olivera said she wanted to stay clear of drugs for good. She had just given birth to twin daughters. Her family recalled her as a loving sister who always kept in touch. She was careful on the streets and was known to carry a screwdriver or other weapon as protection. Despite her troubled life, Lineida Olivera had a kind heart, her sister Marilyn Olivera said. She was generous and would respond to anyone needing help. She was always smiling and feeling optimistic about the future, Olivera said. Her favorite dishes were pernil, or roast pork shoulder, and arroz con gandules, or rice with pigeon peas.

cases.narrative: On 9/4/2007, her scattered skeletal remains was found by a hunter checking his tree blind for the upcoming deer hunting in Rutland, MA.
